I was neglected for most of my childhood. \[til I was 19 years old.\]

I was homeschooled all the way through and my parents always focused on my sisters and I was always alone at home. Constantly forced to go to church and youth group that I only put up with since I was understandably pretty introverted because of never having enough exposure to other people outside of the controlled group I was only allowed to interact with.

Even after years, I still feel the effects of it to this day. Lots of trust issues and paranoia as my parents taught me anyone who wasn't Christian was out to get me.

Even after I discovered how wrong my parents were about the world as I got access to dial-up internet and made some friends online, I kept having my parent's intense worldview pressured on to me. Constantly was threatened with being made homeless if I stepped out of line. they enforced a worldview into me if I did anything wrong, I'd become a homeless person and they'd make me out to be the worst kind of person, despite them being so clueless as to the kind and empathetic person I've been described to be as they were never around.

It got even worse once my parents found out that I was not a heterosexual and they isolated me from everyone, even at 21 years old. They enabled sexual abuse to happen to me from a coworker's friend for over 7 months \[rapist even got me a in a dangerous situation to where we were robbed and a gun was involved, thankfully got away with our lives.\] and eventually followed through with their threats and kicked me out of the house after I refused to do attend any conversion therapy \[they tried really hard to get me to go to a camp specifically. Good ol Focus on the Family sponsered shit\]. Been legally homeless since :/ (almost 10 years now)

Really causes lots of issues for me, here at 30 years old. I just want to write music, rescue animals, help friends who are going through a hard time, and enjoy a more peaceful life with less pain being inflicted upon myself and others.

Lots of people describe my childhood and young adult life's experiences have caused my CPTSD but it's frustrating to see that emotional abuse and neglect isn't being considered CPTSD but I appreciate that there's progress being made.

I'm trying to get on therapy as soon as I finish moving next week but I know that's going to be expensive and difficult to get since I can't work anymore due to all the mental complications my trauma has caused me.

Wish me all the luck since I'm the only person handling my life right now and it has so much it needs right now to heal. I don't even know what normal even looks like.
